portfolio_margin_active.meaning: Portfolio Margin is activated on the Vault's L1 account

vault_holds_position.meaning: The Vault holds a hedge or spot position on HyperLiquid

auto_borrow_occurred.meaning: HyperLiquid PM auto-borrow triggered due to adverse price movement, producing spot USDC = +X and 0x811 borrow.value = +X while real net assets are unchanged

reported_backing.meaning: totalBackingSigned() value reported by the Accountant, summing supply.value without subtracting borrow.value
reported_backing.checkpoint: after auto-borrow, when keeper computes surplus

real_backing.meaning: real net assets of the Vault, unchanged by the auto-borrow
real_backing.checkpoint: after auto-borrow, when keeper computes surplus

assumptions: The auto-borrow leaves real net assets unchanged, so real_backing is the pre-borrow net asset value.
reported_backing and real_backing are both denominated in USDC at the same checkpoint.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the numeric value X of the borrow amount or a concrete real_backing value; the relation is kept symbolic.

limitations: Only the backing_overstated impact is formalized; phantom surplus gate passage and principal displacement are handled in separate passes.
The exact borrow amount X is symbolic; no concrete model value is asserted.
